standards.title: World Bank debt sustainability framework resources
standards.version: Operational framework and country applicability must be checked per run
standards.interpretation: The date identifies the previously operational LIC-DSF generation, not a fresh release or a rule for all sovereigns. Select LIC-DSF versus the market-access-country framework and fetch the actual latest country DSA.

standards.title: IMF Executive Board 2026 LIC-DSF review
standards.interpretation: Board review September 9, 2026. Revised framework expected operational in H2 2027; do not apply reforms as currently operational on September 24, 2026. Our arithmetic helper is not an IMF/WB DSA implementation.

standards.title: IMF / World Bank debt-for-development swaps approach
standards.interpretation: Reference methodology, not legal advice, certification, or evidence of issuer compliance. Verify applicability and the underlying text for each research run.

standards.title: Global Fund Debt2Health programme
standards.interpretation: Debt2Health describes negotiated debt swaps for health. Programme participation does not itself create a publicly tradable instrument or establish net fiscal additionality.

standards.title: IFC blended-finance principles
standards.interpretation: Analyse rationale, additionality, minimum concessionality, crowding-in, commercial sustainability, market reinforcement and standards. Mobilisation ratios alone do not establish additionality.
